# Agent Python Tools

- repo: sgl-project/sglang
- repo_uri: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang

## File: sgl-project_sglang/python/sglang/srt/plugins/hook_registry.py

Prompts

```
['register a before, after, around, or replace hook on a target function or class by fully-qualified path', 'apply all registered hooks to their target functions and classes via monkey-patching', 'wrap a function with a before, after, around, or replace hook using the plugin_hook decorator', 'reset all registered hooks and patched targets for testing', 'replace a class entirely with a custom subclass using HookType.REPLACE on a class target']
```

Usage

```
{'register_hook': 'register a before, after, around, or replace hook on a target function or class by fully-qualified path', 'apply_hooks': 'apply all registered hooks to their target functions and classes via monkey-patching', 'wrap_function': 'wrap a function with a before, after, around, or replace hook using the plugin_hook decorator', 'reset_hooks': 'reset all registered hooks and patched targets for testing', 'replace_class': 'replace a class entirely with a custom subclass using HookType.REPLACE on a class target'}
```
